description: This file defines interfaces for IPC channels and their factory within the Rialto project, including the IChannel and IChannelFactory classes, which facilitate creation, connection management, and event subscription for IPC communication.

classes.name: IChannelFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing IPC channel instances, including methods to create channels based on socket path or file descriptor.

classes.name: IChannel
classes.description: Interface representing an IPC channel, providing methods for connection management, event processing, and message subscription.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Static method to create a shared pointer to an IChannelFactory instance.

methods.name: createChannel
methods.description: Creates a connected IChannel object based on a socket path.

methods.name: createChannel
methods.description: Creates a connected IChannel object around a socket file descriptor.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the IPC channel from the socket.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the IPC channel is currently connected.

methods.name: fd
methods.description: Returns the epoll file descriptor associated with the channel.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for I/O events or timeout on the channel.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes a single event on the channel, such as a socket message or timeout.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to an event message of a specific protobuf message type.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes from a previously subscribed event.
